description_en: Queries the cross-region backup settings of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询跨地域备份设置
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-instance-cross-backup-policy --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceCrossBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

BackupEnabled.description_en:
The status of the cross-region backup feature. Valid values:
Disable: disabled.
Enable: enabled
BackupEnabled.description_zh:
跨地域备份总开关，取值：
Disable：关闭
Enable：开启

BackupEnabledTime.description_en: The time when cross-region backup was enabled. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupEnabledTime.description_zh: 跨地域备份开启时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

CrossBackupRegion.description_en: The ID of the destination region for cross-region backup
CrossBackupRegion.description_zh: 跨地域备份的目的地域ID

CrossBackupType.description_en: The storage type for cross-region backup. Default value: 1, which indicates that each backup is retained
CrossBackupType.description_zh: 跨地域备份保存类型。默认值：1，表示每个备份都保存

DBInstanceDescription.description_en:
The instance name. The name is 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character.
The name cannot start with http:// or https://
DBInstanceDescription.description_zh:
实例名称，长度为2~256个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头

DBInstanceStatus.description_en: The instance status. For more information, see [Instance states]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html）
DBInstanceStatus.description_zh: 实例状态。详情请参见[实例状态表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html）

LockMode.description_en:
The lock status of the instance. Valid values:
Unlock: The instance is not locked.
ManualLock: The instance is manually locked.
LockByExpiration: The instance is automatically locked due to instance expiration.
LockByRestoration: The instance is automatically locked before a rollback.
LockByDiskQuota: The instance is automatically locked because the storage space is exhausted. The instance is inaccessible
LockMode.description_zh:
实例锁定状态，取值：
Unlock：正常，没有锁定。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。
LockByExpiration：实例过期自动锁定。
LockByRestoration：实例回滚前的自动锁定。
LockByDiskQuota：实例空间满自动锁定，不可访问实例

LogBackupEnabled.description_en:
The status of the cross-region log backup feature. Valid values:
Disable: disabled.
Enable: enabled
LogBackupEnabled.description_zh:
跨地域日志备份开关，取值：
Disable：关闭
Enable：开启

LogBackupEnabledTime.description_en: The time when cross-region log backup was enabled. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
LogBackupEnabledTime.description_zh: 跨地域日志备份开启时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

RetentType.description_en: The retention method for cross-region backup. Default value: 1, which indicates that backups are retained based on the specified retention period
RetentType.description_zh: 跨地域备份保留方式。默认值：1，表示按时长保留

Retention.description_en: The number of days for which cross-region backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 1825
Retention.description_zh: 跨地域备份保留天数，取值：7~1825
